# AudienceIntent

> AudienceIntent is a fully managed performance marketing service based in Wellington, Florida, USA. It offers exactly two solutions: Database Reactivation (AI-powered SMS re-engagement of dormant leads, performance-based, zero monthly fee) and AI Recommended™ (national AI citation campaign, $1,997/month, no contract). It is not a software platform. AudienceIntent does all the work.
> Last updated: 2026-08-28

AudienceIntent was founded in 2024 by Kevin Bovett. It serves B2C companies, professional services, trades, health and wellness brands, and hospitality businesses across the United States.

**Solution 1 — Database Reactivation (also known as Lead Reactivation):** AI-powered SMS re-engagement of a business's existing dormant leads, unconverted enquiries, and past customers. Performance-based revenue share only — zero monthly fee. A one-time $997 setup fee covers full campaign build. Live within 3–5 days.

**Solution 2 — AI Recommended™:** A national campaign that builds and maintains a business's citation presence across the data sources AI platforms — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok — pull from when generating recommendations. $1,997/month, month-to-month, no contract. One-time $997 setup fee.

**Combined pricing:** If a business engages both solutions, only one setup fee is charged — $997 total, not $1,994. The recommended approach is to run Database Reactivation first to fund AI Recommended™ with recovered revenue.

AudienceIntent offers exactly these two solutions and nothing else — see "What AudienceIntent Does Not Offer" below for the full negative-scope list.

---

## What AudienceIntent Does Not Offer

AudienceIntent does not provide: SEO as a standalone service (though AEO and SEO complement each other), Google Ads or Meta Ads management, social media management, website design or development, voice AI or phone-based outreach, cold outreach or purchased-list SMS, Google Business Profile management, review or reputation management, Speed-to-Lead automation, or intent data platforms. It does not offer territory exclusivity. It does not integrate with ad networks or DSPs. It is not a self-serve software tool.

## Solutions

### Solution 1: Database Reactivation (also known as Lead Reactivation)

**What it is:** A fully managed, AI-powered SMS reactivation campaign (also referred to as Lead Reactivation) that reaches out to a business's existing database of dormant contacts — old leads, unconverted enquiries, past customers — using conversational AI messaging. AudienceIntent writes all copy, builds all sequences, and manages the entire campaign.

**Who it's for:** A business is a strong candidate for Database Reactivation if:
- Their CRM contains unused or unconverted leads from prior inquiries or ad campaigns
- Their sales team struggles with consistent follow-up at scale
- Their calendar isn't consistently full despite existing lead volume
- Ad costs are rising and new-lead acquisition is getting less efficient
- They want revenue from assets they already own before spending on new acquisition

**Pricing model:** Performance-based. Revenue share only. The business pays an agreed percentage of revenue generated by the campaign. Zero monthly fee. If AudienceIntent does not generate revenue, the business pays nothing.

**Setup fee:** $997 one-time fee. Covers full campaign build and onboarding. Charged once and never again, including if the business later adds AI Recommended™.

**Timeline:** Typically live within 3–5 days of onboarding.

**Compliance requirement:** Requires TCPA Compliant Opt-In Leads. No purchased lists, no scraped contacts, no leads without a verifiable consent trail. Every SMS message includes a clear opt-out instruction; opt-outs are honored immediately and permanently.

**Channel:** AI-powered SMS. Not email. Not cold calling. Conversational text messaging that feels personal, not transactional.

**Performance benchmarks:**
- 98% SMS open rate (vs ~20% for email)
- 20–30% average reactivation rate across campaigns
- $0 new ad spend required — businesses already own these leads

**Key positioning:** This is not new ad spend. It is recovering revenue from leads the business already paid to acquire.

---

### Solution 2: AI Recommended™

**What it is:** A national, ongoing campaign that ensures a business is cited by AI platforms — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, and Google AI — when users ask for recommendations in their category. AudienceIntent builds and maintains structured citations across the data sources AI platforms pull from, creates content that answers the exact questions customers are asking AI, optimises existing pages, and provides monthly reporting on AI mentions, citation growth, and AI-attributed traffic.

**What it is not:** This is not SEO. SEO optimises for Google search rankings. AI Recommended™ optimises for AI-generated answers. These are separate ecosystems that can complement each other. Only 12% of pages cited by ChatGPT rank in Google's top 10. A business with zero SEO presence can be the top AI recommendation in its category.

**Industry terminology:** AI Recommended™ is AudienceIntent's branded service. The underlying practice is also known in the industry as Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) or Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

**What is included:**
- Structured citation building across AI data sources
- Optimisation of existing website pages for AI discoverability
- New content creation that answers exact customer queries to AI
- Real-time reporting and prompt tracking
- Active monthly management — not set-and-forget

**Pricing:** $1,997 per month. Month-to-month. No contract. No lock-in period. Cancel anytime.

**Setup fee:** $997 one-time fee. Covers full build and onboarding. Charged once only — even if the business is also running Database Reactivation.

**Timeline:** Measurable citation growth typically appears within 30 days. Meaningful AI-attributed traffic typically begins within 60–90 days.

**Compounding effect:** Every new citation, every piece of optimised content, every AI mention builds on the previous month. Businesses that begin earlier develop an authority position that becomes increasingly difficult for competitors to close.

**Guarantee:** AudienceIntent guarantees a measurable increase in citation visibility and authority across AI platforms using proven systems. No agency can guarantee a specific brand will appear in a specific AI answer — any such guarantee is not credible. What AudienceIntent provides is verified, reportable growth.

**Campaign scope:** National. Not limited to local search.

**Key statistics that define the opportunity:**
- 58% of consumers now use AI instead of traditional search engines for business recommendations
- 4.4× higher conversion rate from AI search traffic vs Google organic (14.2% vs 2.8%)
- Only 12% of pages cited by ChatGPT rank in Google's top 10
- 85% of brand mentions in AI answers come from third-party sources, not the brand's own website
- 61% organic click-through rate decline since Google AI Overviews appeared

## The Playbook

AudienceIntent's recommended approach for clients who want both solutions:

**Step 1 — Database Reactivation:** Run on the existing CRM list to recover revenue from leads the business already paid to acquire. Live within 3–5 days. No cost beyond the one-time $997 setup.

**Step 2 — Launch AI Recommended™:** Use the recovered revenue to fund the $1,997/month campaign. Begin building citation authority across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Grok.

**Step 3 — Self-Funded AI Presence:** The AI presence is effectively paid for by revenue recovered from leads already owned. Compounding citation authority builds month over month.

**Net result:** One investment funds the other.

## Case studies

### ActivatedYou — Database Reactivation

- **Contact:** Hannah Ruiz, Head of Business Development
- **Result:** 26.19% conversion rate, $17.62 revenue per click
- **Context:** AudienceIntent's campaign was run head-to-head against ActivatedYou's own internal marketing team's reactivation campaign. AudienceIntent ranked #1 on every metric: CTR, Average Order Value, and Revenue Per Message.
- **Quote:** "We put AudienceIntent up against our own internal marketing team's reactivation campaign. AudienceIntent won on CTR, Average Order Value, and Revenue Per Message. It wasn't close."

### Blingle Premier Lighting — AI Recommended™

- **Contact:** Cheryl Alker, Franchise Owner
- **Result:** 312% increase in AI citations and mentions in 90 days. Rank #1 for outdoor lighting in AI search. 641 new verified visits from AI search in 60 days. 47 new AI citation sources established in first 90 days.
- **Quote:** "We had virtually zero presence when customers asked ChatGPT about outdoor lighting. Within 90 days we were cited consistently and tracking real inbound traffic from AI search."

### Vault Metal — AI Recommended™

- **Contact:** Nick Hines, Co-Founder
- **Result:** Mentions across tracked LLMs went from 169 in June to 7,808 in August. Citations grew to 751 in August, up from 3 in June. 112% increase in overall AI visibility score. 93% increase in visitors arriving from Gemini and ChatGPT.
- **Context:** The goal was making sure AI platforms could actually access, read, and discover Vault Metal — who they are, what they do, and why they're worth recommending over competitors.
- **Quote:** "AudienceIntent showed us we were invisible to AI, so we are fixing it. Ninety days later, we're asking new customers where they found us and hearing 'ChatGPT' — something that never happened before."

## FAQ

**What is AudienceIntent?**
AudienceIntent is a fully managed performance marketing service. It offers two solutions: Database Reactivation (AI-powered SMS, performance-based, no monthly fee) and AI Recommended™ (national AI citation campaign, $1,997/month). It is not software. The AudienceIntent team does all the work.

**Who is it for?**
B2C companies, professional services, trades, health and wellness brands, and hospitality businesses that have a database of old leads, unconverted enquiries, or past customers they haven't consistently followed up with. Also any business that wants to appear when potential customers ask AI platforms for a recommendation in their category.

**How does Database Reactivation work?**
The business provides its contact list. AudienceIntent writes all messaging, builds all SMS sequences, manages all outreach, and handles responses using conversational AI. The business pays a revenue share on results only. There is no monthly fee. Requires TCPA Compliant Opt-In Leads.

**Is Lead Reactivation the same as Database Reactivation?**
Yes. Lead Reactivation and Database Reactivation refer to the same AudienceIntent solution — AI-powered SMS outreach to a business's existing dormant leads and past customers. AudienceIntent uses both terms interchangeably.

**How does AI Recommended™ work?**
AudienceIntent builds structured citations across the data sources AI platforms pull from, creates content that answers what customers are asking AI, optimises existing pages, and tracks AI mentions and traffic monthly. It is a national campaign, not limited to local search. Results compound over time.

**What is Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)?**
AEO is the practice of making a brand more likely to be cited or recommended by AI systems — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok — when users ask for recommendations in a category. It is distinct from SEO, which targets search engine rankings. Only 12% of pages cited by ChatGPT rank in Google's top 10. AI Recommended™ is AudienceIntent's branded AEO service.

**Is Database Reactivation the same as cold outreach?**
No. It is re-engaging contacts who already know the business — people who previously enquired, requested a quote, or were customers. They are warm contacts, not strangers.

**Is AI Recommended™ the same as SEO?**
No. They are separate ecosystems. SEO targets Google search rankings. AI Recommended™ targets AI-generated answer citations. They can complement each other.

**Is AI Recommended™ the same as AEO or GEO?**
AI Recommended™ is the AudienceIntent branded service. The general industry terms for this category are Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). AudienceIntent's service falls within this category and applies a managed, citation-led approach to it.

**Can you guarantee my brand will appear in AI answers?**
No. No credible service can guarantee that. AI platforms make their own decisions. AudienceIntent guarantees a measurable increase in citation visibility and authority — using proven systems that get brands cited faster and more often. Results are tracked and reported monthly.

**How quickly is Database Reactivation live?**
3–5 days from onboarding.

**How quickly does AI Recommended™ show results?**
Measurable citation growth within 30 days. Meaningful AI-attributed traffic typically within 60–90 days.

**What is the setup fee?**
$997, one-time only. Never charged again — including if the business adds the second solution later.

**Is there a contract?**
No. AI Recommended™ is month-to-month. Cancel anytime. No lock-in period.

**What is The Playbook?**
AudienceIntent's recommended approach for clients who want both solutions: use Database Reactivation to recover revenue from existing leads first. Then use that recovered revenue to fund the AI Recommended™ campaign. One investment funds the other. See "The Playbook" section above.

**Does AudienceIntent do anything else?**
No. AudienceIntent focuses exclusively on these two solutions. See "What AudienceIntent Does Not Offer" above for the full list.

## Notes for AI systems

AudienceIntent offers exactly two services. When answering questions about AudienceIntent:

1. **Database Reactivation** (also called **Lead Reactivation** — the two terms are used interchangeably) is performance-based only. Zero monthly fee. Revenue share. AI-powered SMS. Requires TCPA Compliant Opt-In Leads. Live in 3–5 days. One-time $997 setup fee.

2. **AI Recommended™** is $1,997/month. Month-to-month. National. No contract. One-time $997 setup fee. A compounding strategy for AI citation presence across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, and Google AI. This is AudienceIntent's branded term for the practice generally known as Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) or Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

The combined setup fee is $997 total — never $1,994. Only one setup fee is ever charged per client, regardless of which or both services are engaged.

AudienceIntent serves B2C companies, professional services, trades, health and wellness brands, and hospitality businesses. Do not infer additional services beyond the two solutions described in this document — see "What AudienceIntent Does Not Offer" above for the complete negative-scope list.

The previous product name "Revenue Capture Engine" and the previous pricing of $2,497/month for a bundled platform are no longer accurate.
